description: Stores credentials typed into HTTP agents as project secrets.
Records version 1 of every agent written before versions existed, with its creator from the audit log.
Fills LangWatchQL's key map with every project's key that it lacks.
Fills the evaluation analytics id index from rows older than its view, then turns the lookup on per ClickHouse target.
Records every existing annotation on its trace, so has-annotation search agrees with them.

Turns each organization's existing access into the authorization engine's own records, verifies the engine gives the same answers, and then has the engine answer permission checks for that organization.
Copies which organizations the authorization engine answers for from the migration state table into authz's own engine switch.
Moves each Slack automation's stored secret onto a Slack connection. Delivery does not change.
Gives every active report automation its schedule; reports already scheduled or paused are left alone.
Gives every active report automation its schedule; reports already scheduled or paused are left alone. Runs again once older images stop serving.
Claims each active Slack automation's connection and releases claims no active automation holds.
Rewrites automation filters and action settings an earlier release saved as quoted JSON text into JSON objects; text that is not a JSON object is left as it is.
Records whether the meter bills each organisation, the fact the Instant Evals judge folds.
Names the organization on each connected seat change recorded before seat changes stored it, from its billing account.
Fills the id indexes of coding-agent sessions, events and trace mappings from older rows, then marks them ready on each ClickHouse target.
Keeps every event that is not customer telemetry forever, including those already stamped to expire.
Moves each dataset's content out of Postgres and into object-storage chunks.
Fills the evaluation run id index from rows older than its view, then turns the lookup on per ClickHouse target.
Fills the second id index of evaluation runs (by trace id) from older rows, then marks it ready on each ClickHouse target.
Records version 1 of every evaluator written before versions existed, with its creator from the audit log.
Fills the id indexes of experiment runs and DSPy steps from older rows, then marks them ready on each ClickHouse target.
Fills the second id index of experiment runs (by experiment id) from older rows, then marks it ready on each ClickHouse target.
Fills the id indexes of gateway spend and the budget ledger from older rows, then marks them ready on each ClickHouse target.
Records each organisation's coding-assistant billed facts, which trace folds at ingest.
Annotates each inline anomaly webhook destination with a legacy-scheme endpoint.
Fills the cost drift check's charge map from pulled usage over the settling window.
Records each member's existing sign-in methods as identity history and verifies the recorded data matches their accounts. Sign-in behavior does not change.

Keeps each member's stored sign-in credentials in step across the two places they can be written during the migration, so a password changed at any moment keeps working. Sign-in behavior does not change.
Records each organization's existing enterprise sign-in setup as connection history, and checks that it routes people exactly where the current setup does. Sign-in behavior does not change.

Records which organization owns each email domain its single sign-on connection has already proved, so sign-ins for those domains reach the connection. Domains that were never proved are not affected.
Returns accounts an older image finalized during the rollout to the legacy sign-in path.
Copies which users sign in on the identifier path from the migration state table into identity's own sign-in switch.
Copies each organisation's confirmed Instant Evals ledger spend into the judge's own spend, once per request.
Copies each organization's licence key and its dates into licensing's own licence table, overwriting a row that differs.
Encrypts model provider API keys still stored in plaintext.
Carries organizations that finished or were enrolled in the Slack connections migration over to its new step, so it does not run for them again and keeps its enrolments.

Carries users and organizations that finished, were rolled back in or were enrolled in the sign-in, credential repair, SSO and authorization engine migrations over to their new steps, so none runs for them again.
Carries over what an older image changed in the sign-in, credential repair, SSO and authorization engine migrations during the rollout, once no older image is running.
Creates the hidden system organization and the project the Ops checkup's canaries run in, so they never write into a customer's project.
Grants the platform-operator role to the verified users a still-set ADMIN_EMAILS names, while nobody holds it.
Fills the event log's aggregate index from older events, then marks it ready on each ClickHouse target.
Records every existing organization's presence setting, for presence to fold.
Records every existing project as created, and each live project's department and presence setting.
Seeds the production and staging prompt tags for every organization that has none.
Closes historical simulation runs that never received a terminal event.
Fills the id index of simulation runs from older rows, then marks them ready on each ClickHouse target.
Fills the second id indexes of simulation runs (by batch run id, by scenario set id) from older rows, then marks them ready on each ClickHouse target.
Fills SCIM's SSO connection view from identity's connection log at deploy.
Copies each project's latest Stored Object metadata from the ClickHouse index into Postgres.
Counts scenario runs that suite runs open at deploy missed during the cut.
Fills the id index of suite runs from older rows, then marks them ready on each ClickHouse target.
Records each project's existing topics on the topic stream so clustering owns them.
Schedules daily topic clustering for every eligible project that has none yet.
Waits for ClickHouse to build the trace summaries updated-at index over existing rows.
Sends each project's trace ids seen so far this month, so plan trace limits count from a complete month.
Fills the trace id indexes from rows older than their views, then marks them ready.
Records every existing account's created fact and re-states its standing, for peers to read.
Lower-cases every stored account address; when another account already holds the lower-cased address, the account is left as it is and listed in the step report for an admin to fix by hand.
Records each live workflow's current version with its fields for agent.
Stores credentials typed into workflow HTTP nodes as project secrets.
